desc.zh: 不改写文本：用 total、term、op 一遍处理乘除优先，再用栈停放括号外层。
desc.en: No text rewriting: total, term and op handle precedence in one pass, and a stack parks the level outside each parenthesis.

complexity: O(n) time for n = len(s); O(d) auxiliary space for parenthesis depth d (at most O(n))

concepts.name: Open term for precedence
concepts.description: Keep total of finished terms plus one signed open term; + and - close it, * and / extend it.

concepts.name: Parking the outer level on a stack
concepts.description: A parenthesis is one number to its outer level; park (total, term, op) at ( and hand the value back at ).
